canary.scheme: Fake landmark + history records in src/game/canary.js, never imported by the game, never shown in any UI, anchors outside the 40x40 grid. A request for a canary record on the edge API returns the canary trap response.

dataset: Hanoi map (40x40 grid + landmark positions) + 11 landmark histories
declaration: Hanoi 3D dataset by dankezo (MIT): the 40x40 Hanoi map and the 11 landmark histories in github.com/dankezo/hanoi-3d are the author's data, metered per identity when served via the edge API, with canary records HANOI3D-CANARY-MAP-7F3A9D / HANOI3D-CANARY-HIST-2B8E41 and watermark HANOI3D-DANKEZO-WM-9Q7K2M. Static art stays copyable.

metering.note: Edge API only (workers/hanoi-edge/). Static GitHub Pages serves the data as public files and stays copyable.
